question: how do i get to the e-learning site
expected_answer: Go to www.embuni.ac.ke and click the E-Learning tab (On-Campus Blended), or type https://e-learning.embuni.ac.ke/

question: what username do i use for e-learning
expected_answer: Your admission number, with the first letter in small letters

question: what are the password rules for the e-learning account
expected_answer: A mixture of a capital letter, numbers and special characters (#, @, $)

question: i made an e-learning account but i cant log in
expected_answer: First confirm the account by clicking the link sent to your student email

question: how do i enrol in my unit on e-learning
expected_answer: Search for the unit on Home, pick the one on your timetable (current semester), then click Enroll me under self-enrolment

question: what can i find on my unit page in e-learning
expected_answer: Web-conference links, welcome message, resources and tools, topics, discussion forums, assignments and CATs

question: how do i join an online class
expected_answer: Open the meeting link, type your names and registration number, enter the room passcode, tick I'm not a robot and click Join Meeting

question: the online class wont let me in what should i check
expected_answer: Check the passcode is typed correctly, clear cache and browser history, check the internet connection and the microphone/earpiece

question: i forgot my e-learning password
expected_answer: Click Lost Password, search with your username or email, open the reset link sent to your email and set a new password
